name: research-mcp
description: Academic literature research: Scopus search, forward/backward citations, relevance screening, abstracts, author metrics and open-access PDFs
long_description:
An MCP server for academic literature research. It combines a Scopus search with three free, open scholarly APIs (CrossRef, OpenAlex, Unpaywall) so you get abstracts, author metrics, citation graphs and open-access PDFs without institutional Scopus entitlements.

You need a free Scopus API key from https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage. The server runs locally; your key never leaves your machine except in requests to Elsevier.

tools.name: search_scopus
tools.description: Search Scopus by query string; returns title, DOI, Scopus ID, citation count and journal per match.

tools.name: get_abstract_details
tools.description: Scopus metadata for a document plus the abstract text from CrossRef.

tools.name: get_author_profile
tools.description: Author h-index, citation count, paper count, ORCID and affiliations via OpenAlex.

tools.name: get_citing_papers
tools.description: Forward citations: papers that cite a given document (OpenAlex by default, Scopus optional).

tools.name: get_references
tools.description: Backward citations: the works a paper cites, via OpenAlex with CrossRef fallback.

tools.name: assess_relevance
tools.description: Screen up to 25 papers against a research context; returns abstracts, topics, keywords and term overlap.

tools.name: get_pdf_link
tools.description: Open-access PDF link for a DOI via Unpaywall.

tools.name: get_quota_status
tools.description: Scopus weekly rate-limit status from the most recent response headers.

scopus_api_key.title: Scopus API key
scopus_api_key.description: Free key from https://dev.elsevier.com/apikey/manage (32 hex characters). Stored securely on this machine.

unpaywall_email.title: Contact email
unpaywall_email.description: Your own email address. Unpaywall rejects requests without one (get_pdf_link), and OpenAlex uses it for its polite pool.
